He kept walking and walking. He saw lots of ants emerge, carrying food; elephants saying they were so big they didn’t know where they could live; and giraffes saying they were so conspicuous that people would spot them as soon as they stepped out of the woods. Although the animals worried about different things, they all backed far away and ran very fast as soon as they saw Chiu Ying.
